description: Defines the PersistentStore class with nested Config, Store2Notification, and RemoteConnectionNotification classes; manages persistent storage, notifications, and remote connection events within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: PersistentStore
classes.description: Main class managing persistent storage, notifications, and remote connection events within the plugin framework.

classes.name: PersistentStore::Config
classes.description: Configuration container for storage parameters such as paths, key, size limits, and limits.

classes.name: PersistentStore::Store2Notification
classes.description: Implements notification interface for store value changes, forwarding events to the parent PersistentStore.

classes.name: PersistentStore::RemoteConnectionNotification
classes.description: Implements remote connection notification interface, handling activation and deactivation events.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the PersistentStore plugin with the given service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers all RPC endpoints and notifications.

methods.name: UnregisterAll
methods.description: Unregisters all RPC endpoints and notifications.

methods.name: endpoint_setValue
methods.description: Sets a value in the persistent store.

methods.name: endpoint_getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the persistent store.

methods.name: endpoint_deleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a key from the store.

methods.name: endpoint_deleteNamespace
methods.description: Deletes a namespace from the store.

methods.name: endpoint_getStorageSize
methods.description: Deprecated method to get storage size.

methods.name: endpoint_getNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Gets storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_setNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Sets storage limit for a namespace.
